title: Juicy Korean Pork Dumplings
description: Garlicky and crumbly Korean dumplings featuring truffle oil, score-fat, and low-fat-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a tandoor-clay-pot
instructions: Preheat the tandoor-clay-pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine ground pork, garlic, truffle oil, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and mix well
Add chopped green onions to the bowl and mix until just combined
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center
Dip your finger in the melted score-fat and run it along the edge of the wrapper
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the dumpling
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
Place the dumplings in the preheated tandoor-clay-pot and cook for 15 minutes
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce
